title: Rainy days recorded at village stations
body: A district office recorded the number of rainy days in a year at 40 village rain-gauge stations and grouped the data as follows. Rainy days 0-10: 5 stations; 10-20: 8 stations; 20-30: 12 stations; 30-40: 10 stations; 40-50: 5 stations. A student is asked to find the median number of rainy days using the formula M = l + (i/f)(N/2 - c), after preparing a column of cumulative frequencies.
